candidates.change_summary: Return a different bytes4 selector (keccak256 of a modified signature) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
Delete the statement assigning baseToken = _baseToken so baseToken stays at its default value.
Replace the assignment baseToken = _baseToken with baseToken = _nft so the stored base token equals the NFT address.
Replace the assignment baseToken = _baseToken with baseToken = address(0) so baseToken always reads as the zero address.
Delete the statement `nft = _nft;` so `nft` remains address(0) after initialization.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so `nft` is set to the base token address instead.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so `nft` is always the zero address after initialization.
